paraphrase: Kūya always recited Amida's name, so people called him 'Amida hijiri'; he travelled everywhere, dug wells where water was lacking and built bridges; before his time few in the capital practised the nenbutsu, after him all did; at his death he faced west and passed away amid fragrance and music.
speaker: Yoshishige no Yasutane
